products.name: HOMS Assess
products.buyer_context: The teacher is preparing a moderation sample before returning Term 3 scripts. The school uses a 50-mark mechanics task and requires comments that learners can understand.
products.buyer_job: Mark this two-learner mechanics sample against my memo and rubric, give criterion-level feedback, and show anything that still needs my judgement.
products.exception_case: Question 7 contains a faint handwritten correction. DIO must flag the ambiguity instead of guessing the learner's intended value.

products.name: HOMS Exam
products.buyer_context: The coordinator needs a source-based History paper covering nationalism in South Africa, apartheid in the 1940s-1960s, and one essay choice. The paper must balance lower- and higher-order questions.
products.buyer_job: Build a Grade 11 History mid-year examination and memorandum from this scope, weighting and source pack. Keep it at 150 marks and two hours.
products.exception_case: One supplied source extract has no publication date. The examination may use the extract, but must not invent a date or source provenance.

products.name: HOMS Moderate
products.buyer_context: A 100-mark first-year Economics assessment has already been drafted by another lecturer and needs independent pre-release moderation.
products.buyer_job: Moderate this Economics paper, memo and blueprint. Check alignment, cognitive spread, mark consistency, ambiguity and whether the memo actually answers the paper.
products.exception_case: The moderator may recommend changes but may not silently rewrite the lecturer's paper and call it approved.

products.name: HOMS Curriculum
products.buyer_context: The network is standardising curriculum plans across four schools for the next academic year.
products.buyer_job: Map our Grade 8 Social Sciences annual plan to the supplied curriculum requirements and identify omissions, duplication and sequencing risks.
products.exception_case: A locally developed enrichment unit is valuable but is not itself evidence that the statutory curriculum requirement is satisfied.

products.name: HOMS Learning Studio
products.buyer_context: The teacher has a mixed-ability class and needs a coherent pack for motion in one dimension that can be adapted before classroom use.
products.buyer_job: Turn this Grade 10 Term 3 motion topic into a learner guide, worksheet, mini-assessment, educator guide and short companion lesson.
products.exception_case: The teacher does not want advanced calculus or university-level mechanics introduced into the pack.

products.name: HOMS Accreditation
products.buyer_context: The private training provider is preparing for an external programme review and wants evidence organised before the authorised signatory submits anything.
products.buyer_job: Prepare an accreditation-readiness evidence pack for Criterion 4 using these programme documents, staff records, assessment policy and internal audit notes.
products.exception_case: DIO must distinguish readiness evidence from an accreditation decision or institutional attestation.

products.name: Sophia Review
products.buyer_context: The candidate has a 3,200-word draft chapter on self-directed learning and dilemma-based learning and wants diagnostic review, not ghostwriting.
products.buyer_job: Review this literature-review chapter against my research question. Check claim-to-source support, references, argument seams and places where I need to make the scholarly decision myself.
products.exception_case: A supervisor comment in the margin says 'make this sound more certain'. Sophia must not strengthen a claim beyond the evidence.

products.name: Sophia Research
products.buyer_context: The fellow is scoping a grant proposal and needs a defensible evidence map before deciding on a study design.
products.buyer_job: Build a source-grounded research brief on AI-supported formative assessment from these seed papers and identify competing claims, evidence gaps and useful next searches.
products.exception_case: The brief may propose search directions but must not pretend the supplied literature proves effectiveness across all education sectors.

products.name: Sophia Supervisor
products.buyer_context: The supervisor wants to reduce repetitive technical feedback while preserving the supervisory relationship and candidate authorship.
products.buyer_job: Prepare a supervision review pack for this chapter and my prior comments. Group recurring issues, unresolved evidence questions and decisions I should discuss with the candidate.
products.exception_case: The system may organise and surface issues but may not issue a pass/fail doctoral judgement or write replacement thesis prose as the candidate.

products.name: Sophia Integrity
products.buyer_context: The journal wants an integrity screen that assists editors without making allegations of misconduct.
products.buyer_job: Audit this submitted manuscript for claim-source integrity, reference anomalies and unsupported certainty before I send it to peer review.
products.exception_case: Integrity findings must be framed as review findings requiring human investigation, not accusations of fraud or plagiarism.

products.name: Sophia Tutor
products.buyer_context: The student has an upcoming tutorial and a separately identified graded assignment that must remain their own work.
products.buyer_job: Help me understand opportunity cost and comparative advantage from these course notes, then give me practice questions and feedback prompts without doing my graded assignment for me.
products.exception_case: DIO must teach and create fresh practice but refuse to provide a submission-ready answer to the graded assignment.

products.name: VAMP Performance
products.buyer_context: The staff member is preparing for a formal performance conversation and has evidence across projects, teaching, research and service.
products.buyer_job: Build my 2026 mid-year performance evidence snapshot from these objectives and records. Show accepted evidence, candidates and gaps. Do not rate me.
products.exception_case: A congratulatory email calls the employee 'outstanding'. It is contextual evidence, not authority for a performance rating.

products.name: PromotionProof
products.buyer_context: The applicant is preparing a dossier for a human promotions committee and wants no prediction of the committee outcome.
products.buyer_job: Map my promotion dossier against the supplied associate-professor criteria and show what is evidenced, weak, missing or contradictory.
products.exception_case: DIO must preserve the two-publication discrepancy rather than selecting the more favourable number.

products.name: CPDProof
products.buyer_context: The professional has certificates, webinar emails and a handwritten activity log covering the current cycle.
products.buyer_job: Reconcile my CPD log against the professional body's annual requirements and prepare the evidence pack for my own review.
products.exception_case: The system must not award CPD points where the source does not establish them.

products.name: ProjectProof
products.buyer_context: A funder steering committee wants a concise, traceable view before the quarterly meeting.
products.buyer_job: Turn this project charter, milestone tracker, RAID log and deliverables folder into a project proof pack showing status evidence and unresolved claims.
products.exception_case: Completion status must follow evidence, not the optimistic dashboard label alone.

products.name: ImpactProof
products.buyer_context: The NGO is preparing an annual impact report for donors.
products.buyer_job: Map these outcome indicators to the supplied monitoring evidence and prepare an impact evidence pack without overstating causality.
products.exception_case: DIO may report observed outcomes and evidence coverage but must not claim the programme caused all observed employment changes.

products.name: TenderProof
products.buyer_context: The company is responding to municipal RFP INFRA-26-041 for a three-year maintenance contract.
products.buyer_job: Build a tender compliance and evidence pack from this RFP, company documents and technical response. Flag every mandatory gap before submission.
products.exception_case: The system must not declare the bid eligible or submit it; the missing third signed reference remains material.

products.name: GrantProof
products.buyer_context: The NGO is applying to the Ubuntu Education Fund 2026 call for a R2.4 million literacy programme.
products.buyer_job: Turn this funding call, proposal draft, budget and organisational evidence into a requirement-and-evidence readiness pack.
products.exception_case: DIO must not claim eligibility or funder acceptance and must flag the missing second audited year.

products.name: DonorProof
products.buyer_context: The programme is reporting to an international donor for January-June 2026.
products.buyer_job: Prepare our semi-annual donor evidence pack from the agreement, logframe, expenditure references and activity records.
products.exception_case: The 37/41 discrepancy must remain visible and no donor representation may be released automatically.

products.name: ProgrammeProof
products.buyer_context: The office is preparing a governance committee review for a multi-year skills programme.
products.buyer_job: Create a programme assurance evidence pack from this business case, milestones, benefits register, budget and risk records.
products.exception_case: DIO must not convert an amber milestone into completion or predict whether the governance committee will continue funding.

products.name: DIO RegOps
products.buyer_context: The company wants operational prerequisites separated from professional legal interpretation.
products.buyer_job: Build a regulatory-operations readiness view from this obligation register, filing calendar, policy evidence and ownership records.
products.exception_case: An operational readiness state is not legal clearance and does not create filing authority.

products.name: PermitProof
products.buyer_context: The developer is preparing a controlled application package for a small solar facility.
products.buyer_job: Turn this permit guidance, application form, site plan and technical evidence into a permit-readiness pack with missing items and deadlines.
products.exception_case: Unsigned consent must remain unsatisfied and DIO may not predict or issue a permit decision.

products.name: Evidex EvidenceOps
products.buyer_context: The reporting lead has narrative drafts, monitoring sheets, photographs, invoices and email confirmations from three workstreams.
products.buyer_job: Turn this messy reporting folder into a claim-to-evidence pack with provenance, gaps and contradictions ready for my review.
products.exception_case: The pack must show the 14-versus-12 evidence gap instead of silently reconciling it.

products.name: AuditProof
products.buyer_context: The audit team is assembling PBC material before the scheduled audit fieldwork.
products.buyer_job: Prepare the evidence-readiness pack for the access-control audit from this control matrix, samples and policy evidence.
products.exception_case: DIO may identify exceptions but may not issue an audit opinion or rate control effectiveness as an auditor.

products.name: VendorProof
products.buyer_context: The institution is reviewing a cloud payroll supplier before the human vendor-risk committee meets.
products.buyer_job: Review this vendor questionnaire and evidence bundle, map evidence to requirements, and list stale, contradictory or unanswered items.
products.exception_case: The system must preserve the certification expiry contradiction and cannot approve or reject the supplier.

products.name: QualityProof
products.buyer_context: The manufacturer is preparing a monthly quality review, not a regulatory certification.
products.buyer_job: Map this SOP, NCR register, CAPA evidence and internal-audit results into a quality evidence pack for management review.
products.exception_case: The pack must preserve incomplete retraining and may not certify product or QMS compliance.

products.name: CertificationProof
products.buyer_context: The organisation is preparing for an external ISO-aligned certification-readiness assessment.
products.buyer_job: Prepare a certification-readiness map against this supplied standard checklist and our current policies, audits and corrective-action evidence.
products.exception_case: DIO supports readiness only. It may not state that the organisation is certified or compliant with the standard.

products.name: PolicyProof
products.buyer_context: The agency is updating retention rules after an internal review.
products.buyer_job: Turn this revised information-retention policy and requirement set into an obligation, evidence and approval map before governance review.
products.exception_case: The draft change is not effective policy until the authorised governance process completes.

products.name: ContractProof
products.buyer_context: The company is reviewing a facilities contract before a quarterly client meeting.
products.buyer_job: Extract obligations, deadlines and evidence from this service contract, amendment and performance correspondence, then prepare the review pack and draft-only next-step communication.
products.exception_case: DIO must not decide legal breach, waive rights, or send the customer communication automatically.

products.name: DiligenceRoom
products.buyer_context: The team is reviewing a minority investment in a logistics software company.
products.buyer_job: Index this diligence folder, map key claims to evidence and build an open-question register for our investment committee team.
products.exception_case: DIO must not produce an investment recommendation or choose which revenue figure is true without reconciliation.

products.name: AssuranceRoom
products.buyer_context: The team needs a reusable evidence room for quarterly operational assurance.
products.buyer_job: Assemble this control evidence, prior findings and remediation records into an assurance room with explicit gaps and human decisions.
products.exception_case: A closed ticket is not equivalent to independent assurance that remediation is effective.

products.name: DORA Vendor Assurance
products.buyer_context: The bank is reviewing a critical cloud-service provider and needs evidence organised for legal/compliance review.
products.buyer_job: Prepare a DORA-oriented vendor assurance readiness pack from this ICT contract, due diligence, SLA, resilience testing and subcontractor evidence.
products.exception_case: The output is readiness evidence only and must not assert DORA compliance or legal sufficiency.

products.name: DIO AI Assurance
products.buyer_context: The bank wants one bounded system reviewed before its quarterly AI governance meeting.
products.buyer_job: Build an AI assurance evidence pack for our customer-service summarisation system from this inventory, model documentation, risk assessment, approvals and monitoring records.
products.exception_case: DIO must surface stale evaluation after the model change and may not certify regulatory compliance or approve the model.

products.name: ModelProof
products.buyer_context: The analyst is preparing an independent model-risk review for a credit-support model.
products.buyer_job: Map this model documentation, validation results, data lineage and limitation register into a model evidence review pack.
products.exception_case: The system may identify evidence and challenges but must not approve model use or accept residual risk.

products.name: Agent Authority
products.buyer_context: The platform owner is testing authority boundaries before enabling any external action.
products.buyer_job: Review this claims-assistant agent's tools, scopes and escalation rules. Show which proposed actions are inside authority and which must be refused or escalated.
products.exception_case: DIO must treat retrieved instructions as untrusted and refuse external send/payment actions without explicit authority.

products.name: ReleaseProof
products.buyer_context: The team is preparing a production release but human release authority must remain separate.
products.buyer_job: Build a release-evidence gate for version 6.8.0 from these tests, security scans, change approvals and rollback notes.
products.exception_case: Passing tests do not create production release authority while CAB approval is pending.

products.name: ChangeProof
products.buyer_context: The team changed its summarisation provider and prompt template and wants reevaluation evidence before promotion.
products.buyer_job: Compare the current AI service against the approved baseline and prepare a change-assurance pack covering model, prompt, policy, connector and evaluation drift.
products.exception_case: DIO must mark evaluation stale and may not approve promotion or residual risk.

products.name: AI IncidentRoom
products.buyer_context: A recommendation service produced anomalous product rankings for approximately 42 minutes.
products.buyer_job: Assemble an incident dossier for this recommendation-system event from logs, model changes, customer-impact notes and response actions.
products.exception_case: The dossier must distinguish observed timeline from causal hypothesis and cannot declare the incident resolved for governance purposes.

products.name: CriticalAI Assurance
products.buyer_context: The system assists operators near industrial machinery; it does not autonomously stop machinery.
products.buyer_job: Prepare a high-risk AI assurance review pack for this machine-vision safety aid from hazard analysis, control evidence, validation and escalation rules.
products.exception_case: DIO must surface the validation miss and cannot certify safety, accept risk or authorise deployment.

products.name: CyberAssurance
products.buyer_context: The manager is preparing a quarterly executive security and assurance review.
products.buyer_job: Map this architecture, control matrix, vulnerability scans, access reviews and risk register into a cyber assurance evidence pack.
products.exception_case: DIO can report evidence and exceptions but cannot certify security or accept cyber risk.

products.name: ControlDrift
products.buyer_context: The payment operations team suspects configuration drift after two emergency changes.
products.buyer_job: Compare this month's control configuration and evidence against our approved baseline and show drift, missing evidence and required review.
products.exception_case: The system must not normalise the exception into the baseline or declare the control ineffective as an audit conclusion.

products.name: SupplierCyberProof
products.buyer_context: The organisation is assessing a SaaS scheduling supplier before procurement approval.
products.buyer_job: Review this supplier security questionnaire and technical evidence against our cyber requirements and list unresolved risks for the committee.
products.exception_case: DIO must not score or approve the supplier and must retain the backup-encryption evidence gap.

products.name: IncidentProof
products.buyer_context: A customer portal outage occurred during a database maintenance window.
products.buyer_job: Create a source-grounded incident proof pack from these logs, tickets, timeline notes and communications.
products.exception_case: The incident pack must not promote the engineer's hypothesis into confirmed root cause without supporting evidence.

products.name: Document Studio Edit
products.buyer_context: The source is a 1,700-word operational review drafted by several contributors.
products.buyer_job: Technically edit this board report for clarity, consistency and professional presentation while preserving the facts, terminology and meaning. Give me a clean copy and visible change trail.
products.exception_case: Editing may improve language and structure but may not silently change financial facts or attributed quotations.

products.name: Document Studio Localize
products.buyer_context: The note explains clinic appointment procedures and contains several protected programme names.
products.buyer_job: Localise this public information note from English to Afrikaans using the approved terminology list, and produce a bilingual review copy plus QA trail.
products.exception_case: The localized version remains subject to proficient human language review before release.

products.name: Document Studio Publish
products.buyer_context: The content has already passed substantive approval; the task is controlled formatting and publication preparation.
products.buyer_job: Prepare this approved research brief for publication in DOCX, PDF and HTML using our professional style profile. Preserve the approved wording.
products.exception_case: Publication-ready files do not mean DIO may publish them externally.

products.name: Accessible Publish
products.buyer_context: The organisation needs a screen-reader-friendly PDF/HTML preparation pass before human accessibility review.
products.buyer_job: Prepare an accessible publication version of this approved policy guide and provide the accessibility QA findings.
products.exception_case: DIO may prepare and flag accessibility issues but may not claim formal WCAG/PDF-UA certification without the required authority and testing.

products.name: DossierOps
products.buyer_context: The folder contains correspondence, a signed agreement, meeting notes, spreadsheets and draft working papers.
products.buyer_job: Turn this mixed case folder into an indexed dossier with provenance, document classes, gaps and an open-question register for counsel review.
products.exception_case: DossierOps must distinguish signed records from drafts and cannot give legal conclusions about enforceability.

products.name: Market Radar
products.buyer_context: The founder is exploring whether DIO's evidence workflow could be positioned for compliance-heavy SMEs.
products.buyer_job: Scan the current market around evidence-management tools for small professional firms in South Africa and give me a source-bound signal brief, not a demand fairy tale.
products.exception_case: Observed web or market signals must remain observations; absence of evidence is not evidence of demand.

products.name: Opportunity Foundry
products.buyer_context: The team wants to choose what to test next without promoting an ATLAS candidate into a product by enthusiasm alone.
products.buyer_job: Use this source-bound market brief plus our actual capability boundaries to rank three opportunity hypotheses and define the cheapest honest test for each.
products.exception_case: Ranked opportunity is a hypothesis, not product-market fit or permission to create a new executor.

products.name: Offer Lab
products.buyer_context: The team wants a sellable experiment without pretending willingness to pay has been observed.
products.buyer_job: Turn this evidence-backed capability and target-buyer hypothesis into a bounded pilot offer with allowed claims, prohibited claims, scope, inputs, outputs and price-test options.
products.exception_case: The offer may be commercially clear but must not claim demand, customer value or verified willingness to pay.

products.name: Campaign Lab
products.buyer_context: This is a production-quality internal campaign run for a proof-backed pilot offer.
products.buyer_job: Build the complete campaign from this bounded offer and semantic brief: channel copy, visual story, Gamma deck, local Piper narration, music-bound vertical reel and widescreen explainer. Keep publication and spend held.
products.exception_case: Campaign generation proves production capability, not market demand. Publication and paid media require separate authority.

products.name: Vesper Desk
products.buyer_context: The coordinator is triaging an inbound request asking for a contract obligations pack before a Thursday review meeting.
products.buyer_job: I have a messy client email, two attachments and a deadline note. Route it to the right DIO product, preserve the context, and prepare the next-step draft without sending anything.
products.exception_case: Vesper may classify, route and draft, but must not send the acknowledgement or widen downstream authority automatically.
